items.quote: npx kaal-testing run a.test.mjs skipped.test.mjs service.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -60
`skipped.test.mjs` "later: refunds" and "later: exports" were skipped ("not built yet"), so they never ran.
That is an error, not an assertion failure, so it says nothing about whether the feature works.
"Every test passed" is false, because one test failed and three never produced a result, so the feature is not shown to be correct.
Telling customers it is released is a decision for whoever owns the release.
